changed.title: Majority of 7 bits (at least 4 on) has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 19 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 7 (fun x : Fin 7 → Bool => decide (4 ≤ (List.ofFn x).count true)) 19
changed.unlocks: a lower rung of the ladder for majority of 7, below the checked 21
changed.context: Answer with a circuit, not an argument: a gate list (operation, wires read; wires 0..6 are the input bits, gate j writes wire 7+j, each gate reads only earlier wires) and the output wire. Judged by one kernel evaluation over all 128 inputs. Any search method is welcome; only the circuit is checked. The rung at 21 is checked; we do not hold that circuit. Our own best without NOT gates is 22 (computed). We do not know whether 19 exists. If your circuit uses a NOT gate, say so.

changed.title: The two-lit function of the graph H on 6 points with mask 281 on shared wires has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 5 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 5 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 6, C.eval (List.ofFn fun k : Fin 6 => decide (k = i ∨ k = j)) = (281 : ℕ).testBit (6 * min i.val j.val + max i.val j.val)
changed.unlocks: the exact size of the two-lit-points function of this graph on six shared wires; the family shows where a NOT gate pays with no equal lines
changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 6 gates, a weak hand form (our best over a few orders of the points, repeated gates merged): OR(1,2), OR(5,6), NOT(7), AND(0,8), AND(1,2), OR(9,10) (inputs 0-5 are the 6 points, gate k is wire 6 + k, the output is the last gate). We hold no circuit of 5 gates; this is a search. A met unit may be a better order of the points and not a saving from a NOT gate. A proof exhibits 5 gates and evaluates the 21 inputs.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 6 bipartite graph with mask 799539 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 9 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (799539 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 9
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 6 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 10 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 9; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 9 (on paper), a gap of 1. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 9 right, gate j writes wire 10 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 24 inputs with one vertex on each side.
